notes.title: Major Update incoming
notes.notes:
I've been pretty quiet lately; hammering away at the Story Update.  During that time, some play testing has been done and I have received some feedback that I need to address.  This means I'll be putting the Story Update on the back burner (sort of).

To start, the world will be changing in a very significant way.  Currently, Neighborhood uses a "fake open world" style where the entire region loads and you roam around it completing tasks.  The issue here is that it creates a lot of empty space in a game where it really doesn't feel warranted.  It also presents a limit on environments and stage types that I don't like being constrained to.  So what does this mean?

Neighborhood is being re-tooled to function in a more linear sense that also allows some mild exploration.  Mild is the key here.  Back tracking will not be an aspect of the game whatsoever.  A central hub will still exist, but will be FAR more robust with more story development as well as more places to explore.  You'll be able to go inside many of the houses and back yards for example.  From a central hub, you will select an area you want to visit and you will be moved to that area.  Levels are going to be shorter, but a bit more demanding.  Additionally, I plan to make much larger more epic boss fights as well.  Each level will have a smaller boss, but expect a super huge boss fight at the end of each world.

Besides the world re-design, I am building a progression system.  I can't give any super specific details, but my overall philosophy is the progression systems will intertwine to allow you to create a very unique character build.  Each upgrade will create some sort of drawback in one way or another which will make "grinding" useless.  It also means you technically don't actually have to level up if you really don't want to.  I definitely want to design it in a way that encourages the exploration however.

Here's a quick overview of my plan:

[b]Character progression:[/b]

Character progression will be gradual and very slight overall.  It is the least important of all progression, but still offers some bonus.  For example: Roy at level 1 will do 20 damage on a light attack.  Roy at level 30 (Max) will do 30 damage. Leveling can be done by exchanging Gummy at a set spot (probably Dojo).  It will exponentially increase cost.  One category (POW, SPD, or HP) can be increased by a set amount  each time.

[b]Weapon progression:[/b]

Weapon progression will allow players to heavily modify their weapons.  Fundamentally this will limit players to altering the weapon balance.  Increasing one stat will reduce another.  Specific items can be exchanged to perform a specific abnormal balance change, but the balance will work like this:

+POW : -HP
+SPD : -POW
+HP : -SPD

An abnormal item can do something like adding to POW while reducing SPD instead.  This will allow for more unique builds.  All non-item modifications will cost Gummy to perform.

[b]Skill progression[/b]

Skill progression will revolve mostly around overall player stats.  Each base skill will have a few branching variations.  In order to "unlock" certain branched skills, a minimum stat requirement will be in place. Example ahead:

Earthquake
Requires : 2 POW, 1 HP, 0 SPD

All about raw damage and is used to finish a combo.  Good for players who want to do as much damage as possible.

Blast Quake
Requires : 1 POW, 1 HP, 3 SPD

A less damaging move that has a smaller damage radius, but it creates a staggering effect on all enemies much farther out.  It is a great move to stop multiple enemies in their tracks momentarily to close distance on a chosen target.

Hyper Quake
Requires : 2 POW, 3 HP, 1 SPD

Hyper Quake is a more focused directional attack that is slower to start up, but includes super armor to help break through enemy offense.  It is most useful for characters with high HP as its slow speed may end up in you getting hit more often.

Anyways, I'm working hard on this update.  Expect it to come out fairly soon!

notes.title: Neighborhood v0.5.7.3
notes.notes:
The Sofie update just went live!

Let's go through all the changes!

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Controls remapped - New layout places key actions on the controller face for easier access.
[*]Reduced super meter gain rate slightly
[*]Changed how NPCs are interacted with to avoid issues with players getting stuck.
[*]AI behavior altered to be more consistent
[*]Adjusted a few back end things for overall optimization
[*]Added camera shake to appropriate moves
[*]Parry mechanics altered to be more strict
[/list]

[b]Sofie[/b]
[list]
[*]Added to the game!
[/list]

[b]Known issues[/b]
[list]
[*]Co-op play may cause strange issues with the camera when interacting with an NPC
[/list]

This patch brings us one step closer to the full story update.  Next up is completing Fizz, the final character after that, and then many small updates to existing characters and enemies.  From there, a multitude of systems and functions need to be put in place to handle the level of story telling we are going for, but we are well on the way!

notes.title: Introducing Fizz : Neighborhood's newest character!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35699208/93d2472533349a12285999edf405096656917072.png[/img]

Fizz is number 3 of 4 in Roy's main group.  Her obsessive love of soda earned her the nick name "Fizz".  She fights with a hula hoop in a highly acrobatic style.  She is also a fan of designer clothing which irritates Sofie to an immense degree.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35699208/876755851b19b55a201b40ad59b7a6382f17b0b6.png[/img]

Fizz is currently in only the final design phases, but her play style is largely planned.  She will be a close to mid-range fighter with average attack power and above average attack speed.  She will be highly mobile with an expansive moveset.  Expect a lot of complex strings and stances!

notes.title: Big update coming!
notes.notes:
Hey all!

I've been away for a bit as I haven't had much time to work on Neighborhood, but I have been plugging away here and there.  I have a big update with a great deal of changes and fixes so let's jump right into it!

[list]
[*] [b][i]New character - Sofie[/i][/b] 
Sofie is a hybrid support character who excels at medium to long range.  She requires effective spacing with her attacks as maximum damage can only be achieved at maximum range.  She also has a few good options for burst healing as well as great offensive options.  Of course, if you have no need for healing, you can simply ignore those skills and go full offense.  Her damage output is below average and her attack speed can be slow, but she more than makes up for it with her extreme range.

[*] [b][i]New default control layout[/i][/b] 
After a great deal of testing and feedback, the default control layout is changing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35699208/8e592ce1e55613727aff1b7a286a1a9638de8d63.png[/img]

[*] [b][i]Dialogue fixes[/i][/b]
All players are now locked during any NPC interaction.  This should help prevent team mates from wandering off.  it should also keep a few issues revolving this from popping up as often.

[*] [b][i]AI fixes[/i][/b]
AI behavior has been adjusted to be more consistent.  Enemies no longer get stuck in certain states and enemies are now capable of evading and defending.

[*] [b][i]Audio fixes[/i][/b] 
Audio pitch and volume no longer rapidly changes under rare circumstances.  Also a gap in audio zones have been fixed.

[*] [b][i]Camera shake[/i][/b]
Certain moves now have a camera shaking effect added to them.

[*] [b][i]Parry overhaul[/i][/b] 
The parry was a little too lenient.  It has been altered to require a tighter timing, but can be affected by certain equipment items.

[*] [b][i]General notes[/i][/b]
A lot has gone into making things run smoother.  A great deal of optimization has gone into making characters take up less resources which should lower the minimum requirements quite a bit.  There should also be less frames dropped in very rare heavy situations.
[/list]

Anyways that does it for this update.  More to come soon!

notes.title: New character incoming!
notes.notes:
Here's Sofie!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35699208/987fcbeb4fef5bb224f915aeaee6bb5c615fad18.png[/img]

She's Roy's best friend and her development marks the beginning of the story update.  This large update will be introducing things like the main cast, expanded sections of Verdemont Heights, voice acting, cutscenes, and more.  Some of the content will be added bit by bit, but other sections will either come in large chunks or all towards the end of development.

Anyways back to Sofie.  She will be a somewhat of a support character with extremely long range whip attacks.  Her support skills will require direct activation and will be more focused unlike Fatima's support skills.  Her playstyle will require you to maintain as much distance as possible since she'll do vastly more damage at the tip of her whip.  Additionally, her health and general ability to heal herself will be more limited, so careful play will be required.

Finally you may have noticed a slightly different art style.  It's a direction I'm experimenting with.  Let's see how that goes.

notes.title: Early access release incoming!
notes.notes:
September 24th is coming up and that means Neighborhood will be released soon!  A few quick notes about the initial release just to be aware:  

Since I am a one person dev team (for now), I have done my best to QA Neighborhood, but expect a few oddities here and there. I am hoping for nothing game breaking, but if something like that comes up, please let me know what happened to the best of your ability and I'll do my best to fix it.

I am in the process of creating new additions to the game to add a bit more variety.  Since the current version is only one "area" I am working to bring value to replayability as well as expanding the game as time goes along.  I consider the first area to be complete enough to give an idea of how the game should function on a basic level.  It takes me roughly 45 minutes to an hour to complete.  I would expect new players to take a bit longer.

Ok so the demo is short(ish).  As a result there is no saving of any kind other than achievements of course.  I intend to add a ton of achievements over time.  For now, enjoy what I have added.  Mostly I am testing the system out to make sure it actually is functional.  Speaking of achievements; one of them might actually be impossible.  I'm not actually sure, to be honest.  "Skill Pro" is the achievement in question.  It requires you to beat the entire area without taking a hit.  A hit only qualifies as an attack that you didn't guard or parry.  You can still get an X rank by taking damage.  I've gotten close at 8 hits, but let's see if it's possible.

I'm working on 2 updates right now.  One should be ready soon, and one which is a larger update that will take some time.  

The first update is a weapon system.  You'll be able to buy and trade weapons which will alter your character's base stats and allow slight range increases or decreases in some cases.  This will tie into a progression system that I have a s future plan as well.

The second update is the story update where I will complete development on the first area by building the actual story of the game out.  This update will change how adventure mode functions to a degree.  More updates on that will be shown as I move forward.  This is a large update since I will be getting voice actors for each of the characters to start.  Also multiple new characters will need to be created.  With the exception of Roy, the characters included in Neighborhood are not relevant to the beginning of the story.  This means I'll need to create 3 new characters to round out Roy's squad.  I'll also be creating cut scenes and all that stuff so look forward to that.

As a side note (concerning cut scenes), you can have a look at the video below if you like.  It is intended to be a scene somewhat close to the opening of the game.  It's a test scene I did a few years back for an annual film festival at my old job.  While the visuals and overall styling of the film will change in many ways, it still gives a good idea of my plans for Roy and his character.  Yes it's all a bit of a mystery, but it will all become apparent soon enough.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mwm5wcLWXiA

That pretty much does it for now.  More updates to follow as I move forward into development.  I hope you all enjoy Neighborhood!
